runifold.owns: Public re-exports, ProviderRuntime and ergonomic composition
runifold.does_not_own: Transport wire formats and a second execution loop

runifold-core.owns: Run identity, authority, budgets, cancellation, events and checkpoints
runifold-core.does_not_own: Provider, protocol, storage backend and application policy implementations
local_rules: RF-LAW-001: no model/provider/protocol/store dependencies in the kernel.
RF-LAW-003: parent authority and structured run lifetime remain enforceable.
runifold-core.extension: Prefer kernel-neutral contracts. A protocol-specific need belongs in an edge adapter; test cancellation, budgets and authority when changing RunContext.

runifold-model.owns: Provider-neutral content, model invocation, streams, routing and retry contracts
runifold-model.does_not_own: Vendor wire types and Agent tool loops

runifold-agent.owns: Canonical model/callable loop, review, structured completion and sessions
local_rules: RF-AGENT-LAW-001: prompt, run, stream, checkpoint and session execution share the canonical engine.
RF-AGENT-LAW-002: reviewers receive attenuated parent authority.
RF-TOOL-003: callable dispatch preserves explicit capability checks.
runifold-agent.extension: Before changing callable dispatch, read ../runifold-effect/AGENTS.md and the modify-agent-loop recipe; test both agent and effect crates.

runifold-tool.owns: Typed tool descriptors, registry, input validation and safe errors

runifold-effect.owns: Write-ahead effects, stable replay identity and explicit recovery
runifold-effect.does_not_own: Vendor-specific business handlers and guaranteed remote exactly-once delivery
local_rules: RF-EFFECT-003: ambiguous non-idempotent effects cannot be retried without evidence.
Stable keys bind capability, effect class and canonical input. Completed outcomes replay without handler execution.
runifold-effect.extension: Add handler-specific reconciliation through EffectReconciler. Keep durable Started/Completed transitions and observability failure behavior intact.

runifold-workflow.owns: Deterministic composition, durable steps, workers, leases, timers and signals

runifold-providers.owns: Feature-gated vendor transports and canonical protocol projection
runifold-providers.does_not_own: Kernel semantics and hidden Agent loops
local_rules: RF-LAW-001: wire DTOs remain inside edge adapters.
Canonical streams require a valid lifecycle; preserve unsupported semantics explicitly.
runifold-providers.extension: Add compatible profiles to the existing protocol family; native protocols get a feature-gated module and loopback conformance tests. Test both isolated features and no-default-features.

runifold-provider-testkit.owns: Loopback protocol cassettes, conformance and benchmark contracts

runifold-mcp.owns: MCP client/server protocol and runtime adapters
runifold-mcp.does_not_own: Changes to core authority or model IR for MCP wire formats

runifold-retrieval.owns: Provider-neutral retrieval, documents and semantic-memory contracts
runifold-retrieval.does_not_own: A mandatory vector database or opinionated RAG application

runifold-retrieval-text.does_not_own: Model execution and remote vector stores

runifold-store-sqlite.owns: SQLite implementations of durable runtime stores
runifold-store-sqlite.does_not_own: A separate execution model or implicit unsafe recovery

runifold-store-postgres.owns: PostgreSQL implementations of durable runtime stores

runifold-observability-otel.owns: Optional OpenTelemetry projection of canonical observations
runifold-observability-otel.does_not_own: Core event semantics or default prompt capture

runifold-ops.owns: Read-only execution inspection, evidence and value-free diffs
runifold-ops.does_not_own: Executing replayed model calls or external writes

runifold-cli.owns: Operational commands and AI development context/diagnostics
runifold-cli.does_not_own: Runtime implementation or executing suggested repairs

runifold-testkit.owns: Deterministic models, fault injection and offline evaluation

runifold-eval-cli.owns: Evaluation CLI and CI regression gates

recipes.title: Create an Agent
recipes.production: Construct ProviderRuntime once at application startup and clone it into request handlers. Use .build() to retain the Agent. Use agent.run(input, &run) when the application supplies budgets, deadlines, capabilities or journals.
do_not: Do not rebuild ProviderRuntime per HTTP request: clones share route health and retry state.
Do not implement another model/tool loop.
requirements: OPENAI_API_KEY only when running, not compiling
recipes.runtime_path: ProviderRuntime → AgentBuilder → Agent → canonical execute_state → model/callables → validated outcome

recipes.title: Add a typed Tool
recipes.production: The complete source defines add(input: AddInput, context: ToolContext) and generates add_tool(). Register it with builder.tool(add_tool()). For direct registry invocation explicitly grant its descriptor capability. Use State<T> for host-owned clients and IntoToolError for safe domain error conversion.
do_not: Do not call the handler directly from an Agent loop.
Do not classify a write as Pure.
Do not put host credentials or injected State in the input schema.
requirements: Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
recipes.runtime_path: Agent callable preflight → EffectExecutor → ToolRegistry::invoke → Tool::invoke → output validation → canonical transcript

recipes.title: Return typed structured output
recipes.production: Derive JsonSchema and Deserialize on the same output type. Production provider configuration uses the same builder. Keep local validation enabled; configure explicit bounded completion repair when needed, under the shared run budget.
do_not: Do not treat provider schema acceptance as proof of valid output.
Do not independently choose a different decoder type or silently relax strictness.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
recipes.runtime_path: Canonical Agent loop → candidate → local completion validation / bounded repair → typed outcome

recipes.title: Stream an Agent
recipes.production: Consume the stream incrementally with StreamExt::next in a UI or server; the example collects events only to assert ordering. Keep the Agent and RunContext alive while polling. Handle Err and the terminal Completed event. Dropping a stream can leave an external write ambiguous.
do_not: Do not buffer the entire production stream merely to display text.
Do not equate a model response terminal event with Agent completion.
Do not restart a partially visible or effectful run without checking retry safety.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
recipes.runtime_path: Agent::stream → canonical Agent engine → buffered observer → model/callable/usage events → Completed or Err

recipes.title: Persist a conversation and replay a request
recipes.production: Use the complete credential-free SQLite example. Persist conversation ID, namespace and request ID in the application; reuse the request ID for the same logical request. For process restart recovery preserve compatible Agent/reviewer definitions and follow explicit session recovery. A new request needs a new request ID.
do_not: Do not mint a fresh request ID for each retry.
Do not confuse conversation history, execution journal and semantic memory.
Do not treat emitted text as durable commit; durable streaming reports ConversationCommitted.
recipes.runtime_path: AgentSession admission → stable request/checkpoint identity → canonical Agent/effects → conversation commit → request replay

recipes.title: Add a Provider adapter
recipes.production: Use an existing compatible profile if its protocol already fits. For a native protocol add a feature-gated module alongside anthropic/openai, implement Model and provider identity/capabilities, and project every wire event through canonical model semantics. Update Cargo features, the CI feature matrix and docs/PROVIDERS.md. The excerpt shows the module registration; follow the linked Anthropic implementation for a complete adapter.
do_not: Do not add vendor wire types to core or model contracts.
Do not guess model capabilities or hide retries.
Do not copy a full transport for another endpoint using the same protocol.
requirements: Use the new feature in place of anthropic in validation once implemented
recipes.runtime_path: ModelRequest → adapter wire projection → transport → canonical stream accumulator → ModelResponse

recipes.title: Review an Agent answer before completion
recipes.production: Give the reviewer a stable name and version. Replace the approval closure with your rule and grant only required reviewer capabilities. Use a bounded policy for repairs. Use TurnReviewer for pre-call plan review; terminal review happens after candidate generation and cannot undo an executed write.
do_not: Do not use post-hoc terminal review as authorization for an earlier Tool write.
Do not bypass local structured output validation.
Do not grant a reviewer more authority than its parent.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
recipes.runtime_path: Candidate → local terminal validation → attenuated reviewer → approve / bounded repair / reject → completion commit

recipes.title: Add recoverable external work
recipes.api: Tool effect descriptor; EffectExecutor for low-level effect orchestration
recipes.production: Ordinary Agent Tools already go through EffectExecutor; declare their real effect class and inject a durable executor for cross-process recovery. The excerpt is a low-level contract test showing stable-key replay. Use the durable publication example for receipt reconciliation and crash recovery with a real SQLite store.
do_not: Do not manually nest EffectExecutor inside an ordinary Tool just to obtain Agent recovery.
Do not retry an ambiguous NonIdempotentWrite without external evidence.
Do not claim an in-memory effect store survives process restart.
requirements: runifold with runtime; sqlite-bundled for durable publication
Low-level example uses runifold-effect test helpers
recipes.runtime_path: Capability preflight → stable effect identity → persisted Started → handler / reconciliation → persisted Completed → replay

recipes.title: Compose workflow steps
recipes.production: Each .agent step supplies explicit child capabilities. Keep stable workflow version and step IDs for durable work; configure a durable store and worker for actual execution. This example only assembles the workflow, so it does not demonstrate recovery on its own.
do_not: Do not grant ambient child authority.
Do not change a persisted workflow definition without a migration/version decision.
requirements: OPENAI_API_KEY only to run the assembly example
recipes.runtime_path: Workflow definition → durable worker / step execution → explicit child authority → canonical Agent → persisted step progress

recipes.title: Test a Provider offline
recipes.production: Require exact request JSON, canonical response events, usage and credential redaction. Add rate-limit, malformed stream, disconnect and cancellation cases. Use fake credentials with loopback URLs. The full source includes the SSE fixture helpers.
do_not: Do not use a live vendor key in offline conformance tests.
Do not accept a missing terminal event as success.
Do not substitute mocked Rust responses for wire-protocol tests.
requirements: Local loopback sockets; no vendor credentials
recipes.runtime_path: CassetteServer expected request → real loopback transport → adapter → canonical success/error conformance checks

recipes.title: Use conversation history
recipes.production: This lower-level API loads and appends canonical history with optimistic concurrency. For production request admission and replay use AgentSession and the durable-conversation recipe. Choose a namespace and context-window policy explicitly.
do_not: Do not use conversation history as an execution journal.
Do not assume this lower-level API participates in AgentSession admission.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
recipes.runtime_path: Load conversation → bounded context selection → canonical Agent run → optimistic atomic transcript append

recipes.title: Add retrieval context
recipes.production: Register the Retriever with dynamic_context(limit, retriever). Give it a read-only descriptor, bounded results and explicit authority. The application example below implements a small handbook source; replace its body with your backend while preserving cancellation and deadline handling.
do_not: Do not promote retrieved documents into system instructions.
Do not bypass retrieval capability checks or confuse semantic memory with conversation persistence.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
recipes.runtime_path: Agent context preparation → retrieval capability check → Retriever::retrieve → untrusted user context → model invocation

recipes.title: Modify the canonical Agent loop
recipes.production: Trace entry through run, stream, checkpoint resume and session execution before editing. Extend the single state machine and observation points. Add regression assertions for the changed lifecycle in ordinary, streaming and durable paths; run Agent, Tool and Effect tests.
do_not: Do not add a second model/tool execution loop.
Do not weaken capability checks or replay safety to make the new path pass.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
recipes.runtime_path: Initial state → canonical execute_state → model → turn review → callable effects → completion / terminal review

recipes.title: Change a public API
recipes.api: Owning crate export → facade export → executable contract
recipes.production: Use the public-surface test style shown here to define behavior, then add or change the owning API, explicit facade exports, rustdoc, changelog and the relevant RFC. Review semver compatibility; before 1.0 an incompatible public change needs a new minor release. Use scripts/semver-check.sh with the required release history/tool installed.
do_not: Do not publish an internal helper solely to make a test compile.
Do not claim compatibility from compilation of the new version alone.
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
recipes.runtime_path: Public caller → owning crate API → existing canonical implementation; facade re-exports preserve that path
